App._comment: Public base URL for ABSOLUTE links in emails (cart recovery, order confirmations, campaigns, back-in-stock) and the email logo. Set to the live custom domain. If the domain is not yet serving, temporarily set the App__BaseUrl environment variable in the Render Dashboard to the Render URL (https://sterlinglams.onrender.com) — env vars win over this file — then remove it once DNS resolves. (robots.txt / sitemap.xml use the live request host, so they switch automatically.)

Serilog._comment: Serilog reads THIS section (not Logging:LogLevel). Production only, so dev keeps full SQL for learning. Database.Command at Warning silences the per-query 'Executed DbCommand' echoes while still surfacing command failures (logged at Error). Keeps app + request logs at Information.
